definitions.explanation: The person who leads or presides over a committee. In school contexts, refers to the class representative or homeroom leader.

examples.japanese: {委員長|いいんちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I was chosen as the committee chairperson.

examples.japanese: ⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{委員長|いいんちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{連絡事項|れんらくじこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}えた→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: The class representative conveyed the announcements.

examples.japanese: {選挙管理|せんきょかんり}{委員長|いいんちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The election commission chairperson announced the results.

notes:
{委員長|いいんちょう} is the head or presiding officer of a committee, formed from ⟦{委員|いいん}→委員：01708_iin⟧ (committee member) + {長|ちょう} (head/chief). In school contexts it often refers to the class representative who handles announcements and organizational duties.

TYPES:
- ⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧{委員長|いいんちょう} — class representative
- ⟦{実行|じっこう}→実行：03274_jikkou⟧{委員長|いいんちょう} — executive committee chair
- {選挙管理|せんきょかんり}{委員長|いいんちょう} — election commission chair

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{委員|いいん}→委員：01708_iin⟧ — committee member
- ⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧ — committee; commission
- ⟦{会長|かいちょう}→会長：11610_kaichou⟧ — president (of an organization)
- ⟦{議長|ぎちょう}→議長：02681_gichou⟧ — chairperson (of a legislative body)
